items.title: Hydroplane Races are this weekend on the lake in front of the beach. North Pool boat ramp will be closed Friday Oct. 2 -…
items.excerpt: Sunday Oct. 4 for event set up. All other ramps will remain open. The Beach will be closed to swimming during the event on Saturday and Sunday. Races will take place in front of the beach. Boaters will be allowed to pass through in between races on the far side.
